title: New Releases: CyberCity Character Creator Kit, CyberCity Icons

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
This week, the CyberCity series expands! Adding characters and icons!
​
Create unique heroes, villains, and people just living their best cyberpunk lives with the CyberCity Character Creator Kit! PVGames is here with a bunch of character pieces for their CyberCity series to help you fill your cities with busy citizens. Make tough armored cops carrying multiple guns who block your heroes path, friendly cyborg shopkeepers wearing hoodies who offer blackmarket items for reasonable prices, androids dancers in plastic and metal bodysuits who can offer up helpful rumors, and more with this pack!
You’ll need to be familiar with art programs to make the most of this pack, but if you do then the possibilities are unlimited! With 5 body bases for both male and female characters, you can create fully human, cybernetically-enhanced human, and completely robotic heroes to fit your story and world. Dress your modern characters in t-shirts, hoodies, and leather jackets over black jeans, loose joggers, and athletic shorts before thrusting them into an adventure across the galaxy, or start your story with sci-fi uniforms and strength-enhancing armor so your players know they’re in for a game full of high-tech battles!
And if all those outfit pieces weren’t enough, this pack is designed to give you all the character sprite and portrait images you could want, with each character piece designed to layer over full body portraits with 16 different poses and huge character sheets with animations for walking, running, falling, fighting, and more so you can show tons of emotions during cutscenes. Create your perfect characters and then crop the images to fit RPG Maker’s specifications, or use your favorite character frame plugin to make use of the 8-frame walking animations in 8 directions and other behaviors! So if you’ve been needing some new partially robotic characters to populate your game, or you just love PVGames’ resources, pick up the CyberCity Character Creator Kit!

​
Give your 3D-style game some fitting high-res icons with the CyberCity Icons pack! PVGames is adding to their CyberCity series with a massive pack of 512x512 pixel images to use in cutscenes and inventory menus. Over 800 icons offer up images for vials and weapons, clothing and accessories that match what your heroes are wearing from the CyberCity Character Creator Kit pack, tasty bowls of food, handwritten notes and old newspapers, boxes and objects to examine up close, and more!
Use these icons in your sci-fi detective game to give your players something to look at when searching a crime scene, where interacting with a potted plant in the bedroom reveals an empty injector and a bookshelf holds a small note from the victim that proves someone was stalking them! Or use the food and take-out container images in a minigame where your players need to choose and deliver the right meals around town to make some extra money to buy an upgrade for their robot arm. Give your players a reason to change their outfits in-game by letting them see a close up of each shirt, pants, and accessory before buying and equipping them, or create loot boxes that could be filled with anything from rare wines and expensive paintings to old robot feet and literal piles of garbage that your players can try to sell or use as fuel for a fire. Grab the CyberCity Icons pack and add some extra pizzazz to investigative scenes and to your character outfit menus!
